programs.title: Presentation Skills Masterclass
programs.description: Two-day practical masterclass with filmed practice presentations and individual coaching.

programs.title: Emerging Leaders Programme
programs.description: Flagship programme for first-time managers combining workshops, peer coaching and an action-learning project.

programs.title: Data Privacy & GDPR Essentials
programs.description: Mandatory compliance training covering GDPR principles, data subject rights and breach handling.

programs.title: Advanced Excel & Power BI
programs.description: Hands-on lab programme taking analysts from advanced Excel to self-service BI.

programs.title: Negotiation Mastery
programs.description: Simulation-based programme with role-plays drawn from real procurement and partnership deals.

programs.title: Project Management Professional Bootcamp
programs.description: Four-week exam-preparation bootcamp with weekly mock exams and a capstone project plan.

programs.title: Cloud Fundamentals (AWS & Azure)
programs.description: Vendor-neutral introduction with guided labs in AWS and Azure sandboxes.

programs.title: Coaching for Managers
programs.description: Residential programme blending coaching practice triads with reflective learning journals.

programs.title: Anti-Bribery & Business Ethics
programs.description: Scenario-led compliance session aligned to the UK Bribery Act and FCPA.

programs.title: Agile & Scrum Practitioner
programs.description: Practitioner-level programme culminating in the PSM I certification exam.

programs.title: Strategic Thinking for Senior Leaders
objectives: Scan and interpret the strategic environment
programs.description: Residential executive programme with case studies, a business simulation and guest speakers.

programs.title: Cybersecurity Awareness
programs.description: Organisation-wide awareness programme including a live phishing simulation.

programs.title: Customer Experience Excellence
objectives: Measure CX with NPS and CES
programs.description: Proposed programme for front-line teams following the 2026 customer survey.

programs.title: AI for Business Leaders
programs.description: Pipeline programme requested by the executive committee; awaiting budget approval.

programs.title: Mental Health First Aid
objectives: Recognise signs of mental ill health
programs.description: Accredited two-day course to create a network of mental health first aiders.
